verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect support for content management in the Swell admin. Merchants can integrate custom content with the catalog using custom models and fields that extend the dashboard. There is also a visual theme editor and support for multiple content languages. However, no evidence describes built-in pages, blogs or media management, so this story would need custom models as a workaround. Missing for 10: native pages management, native blog/posts management, media library, independent or hands-on corroboration.
